# scm_dlp_dictionary_list (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Lists Enterprise DLP Keyword Dictionaries.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all DLP dictionarys in the tenant.
data "scm_dlp_dictionary_list" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of dictionaries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total` (Number) Total number of dictionaries.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category of the dictionary.
- `description` (String) A description of the dictionary.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the dictionary.
- `is_case_sensitive` (Boolean) Whether keyword matching is case sensitive.
- `keyword_count` (Number) Total number of keywords.
- `keyword_list` (List of String) List of keywords.
- `name` (String) The name of the dictionary.
- `original_file_name` (String) Original file name.
- `region_name` (String) Region name.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
